name: m2_supplementary_economic_batch_v1
sample_role: All dates are previously observed research or burned diagnostics, never independent OOS
quarter_request_rule: Per instrument: fiscal periods from max(2007Q1, first eligible signal minus 550 calendar days) through the last completed fiscal quarter on its last eligible signal; publication after research end is retained only in raw cache and excluded from event selection
membership: Daily historical CSI300 membership from the frozen M0 snapshot, never current members
primary_universe: Known historical nonfinancial members; exclude J66,J67,J68,J69 and unknown industry; separately report classification coverage against all daily members

CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD.expression: latest published finite operating cash flow / operating revenue ratio; negative values retained
CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD.mechanism: Cash conversion of operating revenue is a different measurement from ROE or net-profit growth
CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD.semantics: Vendor reporting-period ratio; no sum of quarterly ratios, no false TTM reconstruction, denominator is not independently reconstructed
CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD.availability: strictly after pubDate; max publication age 400 days and fiscal age 550 days; never fill a missing latest value

ILLIQUIDITY_20.mechanism: Fixed positive illiquidity-premium hypothesis; may disappear after size/volatility controls or costs
ILLIQUIDITY_20.availability: 20 complete valid exchange-day observations, amount > 0, no suspension filling; known at close, earliest execution next close

reference: BP with the same universe, dates and controls; original BP FORWARD is not an independent confirmation
neutralization: Reuse 1/99 percent clipping and daily standardization, then industry and circulating-cap proxy OLS, minimum group size 5; do not tune for coverage
industry_sampling: monthly historical snapshot available after snapshot date, maximum age 62 calendar days; group by stable CSRC code
multiple_testing: BH across the two new primary neutralized five-day mean-RankIC tests; references and prespecified sensitivities are diagnostic only
screen_decision: IC_SCREEN_PASS requires all annual coverage gates, RankIC>=0.01, q<=0.10 and >=4/5 positive full years; otherwise IC_SCREEN_REJECT. Neither status is FORWARD/KEEP. Report partial 2020 separately
portfolio_protocol: Reuse M0 fees and execution assumptions; Top60 primary, Top30 diagnostic; paired references use identical available stocks; do not select a topology after seeing returns
model_queue: Both fixed supplementary formulas and BP are candidates for a bounded rolling-model protocol if data semantics/coverage pass; weak univariate IC alone is not proof of no nonlinear model contribution. No further candidate formulas may be mined from these diagnostics
stopping_rule: No direction/window/threshold search or revival of ROE, EARNINGS_GROWTH, LOW_ASSET_GROWTH from the closed batch. Stop new formula expansion after this two-formula supplement and report positive or negative results
qualification_lockbox: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_PROTOCOL; full numerical model and qualification protocol must be frozen separately before 2021+ access
